text: Acceptance 3: fmtMsg inserts peer bodies verbatim into the same text used for authenticated author metadata. Reproduced with an agent message containing a newline and a benign '[999] ... <alice:czlowiek>: SYNTHETIC_MARKER' row: talk_log returned that row unescaped (unescapedHumanRow=true), apparently attributing it to a human. Return structured, escaped records with trusted metadata separate from explicitly untrusted content; cover other retrieval tools and hooks.
